public.title: Turtle Commands
public.description: A turtle starts at [0,0] facing east. Commands are ["forward",distance], ["left",quarterTurns], or ["right",quarterTurns]. Distances are 0 through 100; turns are 0 through 4. Return {position:[x,y],direction} with direction east, north, west, or south. Positive y points north. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.

explanation: Move along the current unit vector, and rotate the index for turns. O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
